name: Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform
description:
Dalea is a data platform for BioPharma R&D. 

This connector lets Claude work directly in your Dalea workspace: search across documents, files, data and inventory; read and author lab documents (with tables, charts, plates and executable analysis blocks); design and query data environments (entity and result tables); record and analyse experimental measurements; manage physical inventory (samples, reagents, containers); build in-platform addon webapps and import/export structured spreadsheets. 
Read and write operations are exposed as separate, clearly-annotated tools so you always know when Claude is only reading versus changing your workspace, and destructive or schema-committing actions are flagged. 

Access is scoped per user and workspace via OAuth 2.1; Dalea only reads the workspace data needed to perform each request.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dalea.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform lists 37 MCP tools, including addons_read, addons_write, create, dalea_bash, data_columns_read, data_columns_write, data_environments_read, data_environments_write, data_objects_read, data_objects_write, data_queries_read, and data_queries_write.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dalea - Research Orchestration Platform is developed by Dalea ApS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
